htdt-godogen-asset-gen.description: Generate assets for a game, a video or any other project: images, transparent sprites and animated GIF sprites (GPT-Image-2.6, batched at half price), textured GLB models, rigged humanoids with generated moves and lip-synced speech, sound effects and voice lines (local and free with godogen_assets), 3D built in Blender, plus Grok sprite video, Tripo 3D, Gemini TTS voice acting and Lyria music. Use whenever a project needs generated art, 3D or audio.

htdt-godogen-engine-guide.description: Building on Godot 4 (C# or GDScript), Bevy, Babylon.js, three.js or HTML: which to choose, installing its toolchain, the project sketch, build commands, headless capture to screenshots and video, and the traps that fail silently. Use when starting or working on a game, a video made in an engine (presentation, explainer, trailer, product showcase), an interactive 3D or 2D page, or anything else built on one of these engines.
